label: early copy phase (<DEL> and first ~3 outputs) of long sequences
explanation: Fires almost only after the delimiter: <DEL> step (24% rate, 39% of mass) and the first few copy steps (recall_idx 1-3), with rate rising with L (L=9 has 38% of mass) and with outputs remaining (to_go). Essentially silent in the original phase (0.6% of mass) and in late copy steps (recall_idx >= 5). Predicate captures ~85% of activation mass but precision is low (~22%): within this window, whether it fires depends diffusely on token content (e.g. inputs/first token k, w, l raise the rate; outputs m, z, 1, n), which no simple token set captures. Largest activations come at <DEL> and recall_idx 0-2 of length 8-9 sequences.
